description: Comprehensive UI/UX design blueprint for SmartBite — an intelligent, multi-role Food Delivery and Order Ecosystem (FastAPI + MongoDB, React 19 + Vite + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui base-nova).

locale.date_format: DD MMM YYYY, hh:mm A (e.g., 24 Oct 2026, 08:30 PM)
locale.veg_indicator_style: Green dot in green square border (Veg) vs Red/Brown dot in red square border (Non-Veg) — strict Indian food labeling standard

design_philosophy.archetype: Organic & Earthy with High-Appetite Warmth (Earthy Charcoal, Saffron Apricot, Fresh Basil, Warm Cream)
anti_patterns_avoided: No generic AI purple/indigo gradients (#7351B7 strictly banned)
No cold clinical glassmorphism for food cards
No Inter font for headings (uses Plus Jakarta Sans for punchy, friendly authority and DM Sans for body)
No flat untextured hero blocks — warm terracotta and saffron accents ground the culinary experience
key_principles: Appetizing Tactility: Warm natural backgrounds (#FAF7F2), crisp micro-borders, elevated card geometry
Density with Breathing Room: High-information role dashboards with strict bento grids and asymmetric customer discovery
Radical Transparency: Clear breakdown badges, allergen chips, budget fit trackers, live freshness stage meter
Mobile-First Touch Precision: 48px touch targets, sticky bottom action bars for mobile carts, responsive drawer filters

typesetting_rules.labels_overlines: uppercase text-xs font-bold tracking-[0.18em] text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400

surfaces.name: sticky_header
surfaces.guarantee: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85 dark:bg-[#121110]/85 border-b border-stone-200/80 dark:border-stone-800/80

entry_surfaces./: asymmetric culinary discovery hero with interactive budget slider + AI heuristic recommender pills left, live Bento food showcase right
entry_surfaces./login: split branded auth — warm culinary mission & live platform stats left, role-switching login form right
entry_surfaces./register: split branded auth — multi-role selector (Customer, Restaurant, Delivery Partner) left, step-wise onboarding form right
entry_surfaces./customer: curated marketplace feed with smart budget discovery header, surplus meal flash deals ribbon, and categorized bento restaurant cards
entry_surfaces./restaurant/:id: restaurant header with hygiene & freshness scorecards, sticky category navigation, allergen-safe dish cards with ingredient customization modal
entry_surfaces./cart: split checkout with per-person split bill calculator, delivery batching discount toggle, and itemized transparent fee breakdown
entry_surfaces./tracking/:orderId: live interactive 5-stage Freshness & Prep tracker with simulated GPS courier route map, temperature & ETA badge
entry_surfaces./group-order/:id: collaborative ordering room with live member carts, bill-splitting breakdown, and master checkout lock
entry_surfaces./dashboard/restaurant: high-density order dispatch queue, kitchen prep timer, menu availability toggles, and Recharts revenue/popularity analytics
entry_surfaces./dashboard/delivery: mobile-first delivery cockpit with batch request acceptance, smart route optimization map, and daily earnings breakdown
entry_surfaces./dashboard/admin: ecosystem oversight with live order matrix, partner verification approvals, NGO surplus distribution log, and Recharts fraud anomaly graph

1_smart_budget_discovery.ui_pattern: Interactive Dial / Range Slider with Live Cart Matcher
1_smart_budget_discovery.description: User sets budget (e.g., ₹250). System displays curated combos where Food + GST (5%) + Delivery + Platform fee <= ₹250. No surprise checkout price jumps.

2_ai_recommendation_engine.description: Chips for 'Rainy Evening Warmers', 'High Protein Post-Workout (>30g)', 'Low Calorie Light Bites (<450 kcal)', 'Under 25 Mins Flash Prep'.

3_group_ordering_bill_split.ui_pattern: Collaborative Order Board with Avatar Carts
3_group_ordering_bill_split.description: Unique 6-digit room code or QR. Shows live member items ('Aman: 1x Paneer Tikka', 'Priya: 1x Burrito Bowl'). Options: Equal Split, Itemized Split, or Host Pays.

4_smart_food_waste_reduction.ui_pattern: Flash Surplus Deal Banners with Countdown Timer
4_smart_food_waste_reduction.description: Gold/amber themed 'Saver Hour' badge. Shows original price vs 40-60% discounted rescue price and remaining portions (e.g., 'Only 3 left before 10 PM close').

5_transparent_pricing_module.description: Item subtotal + Restaurant Packaging + Delivery Partner Fee (distance calculated) + Platform Fee (₹5) + Govt Taxes (GST 5%) - Batching Discount. Clear tooltip explaining every rupee.

6_scheduled_subscription_meals.description: 7-day interactive lunch/dinner grid. Users can skip dates with 1 tap, choose cuisine rotation (e.g., North Indian Homestyle, Healthy Keto Bowls), and auto-debit summary.

7_allergen_and_ingredient_transparency.description: Full macro breakdown (Calories, Protein, Carbs, Fats) + high-visibility allergen icons + checkbox for custom instructions (e.g., 'No onions', 'Less spicy', 'Gluten-free crust').

8_smart_delivery_batching.description: 'Combine with a neighbor's order within 500m to save ₹30 delivery fee and reduce 0.8 kg carbon emission' with leaf indicator.

9_community_food_sharing.description: Restaurants tap 'Donate 15 Surplus Meals' → Verified NGO partners (e.g., Feeding India / Robin Hood Army) receive instant pickup request with food safety temp stamp.

10_food_freshness_tracker.ui_pattern: Live Animated Prep Timeline + Simulated GPS Route
10_food_freshness_tracker.description: 5-phase tracker featuring step glow, chef prep timer, temperature indicator (hot packed at 68°C), and moving courier bike icon on route preview.

accessibility.prefers_reduced_motion: All motion components must check `useReducedMotion()` or fallback to simple opacity transitions when enabled.

admin_dashboard.waste_reduction_impact: ComposedChart (Bars: Meals Saved, Line: CO2 Avoided in kg)

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME & COLORS: Retheme 'frontend/src/index.css' to use warm culinary tones (Warm White #FAF7F2 page background, Deep Saffron #E65100 accent, Emerald Basil #15803D secondary). Use @fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans for headers and @fontsource-variable/dm-sans for body copy. Dark theme must use Charcoal #121110 with warm stone borders (#262320).
2. LOCALE & CURRENCY: Use Indian Rupee ('₹') formatting throughout. Use the official Veg/Non-Veg symbol (Green square with green filled dot for Veg, Red square with red filled dot for Non-Veg).

3. ROLE SWITCHING & AUTH: Provide a seamless, visible Demo Role Switcher in the top navigation or banner (Customer, Restaurant Partner, Delivery Hero, Platform Admin) so reviewers and testing agents can switch and experience all 4 ecosystems instantly without tedious re-logins.

4. SEED DATA & MOCK FLOWS: Seed realistic Indian restaurants (e.g., 'Saffron & Spice Kitchen', 'Bao & Bowl Co.', 'Artisan Crust Pizza Lab', 'Green Harvest Deli', 'Dilli Darbar Biryani') with categorized menus, dietary tags, allergen info, surplus deals, and transparent pricing breakdowns.

5. UNIQUE DIFFERENTIATORS: Implement all 10 confirmed differentiators visibly in the UI: (1) Smart Budget Slider on Home, (2) AI Weather/Calorie Heuristic Recommendation pills, (3) Group Order Room with Bill Split, (4) Surplus Food Rescue Deals with countdown timers, (5) Itemized Transparent Checkout Breakdown, (6) 7-Day Tiffin Meal Scheduler, (7) Detailed Allergen & Ingredient disclosure modal, (8) Eco-Batching delivery fee saver toggle, (9) NGO Community Food Share button on Restaurant Dashboard, (10) 5-stage Freshness & Courier Tracking screen with animated bike transit.
6. CHARTS & ANALYTICS: Use Recharts (importing from @/lib/recharts) for the Restaurant, Delivery, and Admin dashboards (Revenue Trends, Top Selling Dishes, Payouts & Tips, Food Waste Avoided).
7. NOTIFICATIONS & FEEDBACK: Use Sonner ('toast.success()', 'toast.info()') for immediate tactile feedback on adding to cart, accepting orders, splitting bills, and dispatching deliveries.
8. COMPONENT CONTRACTS: Use base-ui friendly props with render={<Link />} or buttonVariants({ variant, size }) for routing buttons. Ensure no empty or broken routes in App.tsx.
